exercise.name: Dumbbell Power Clean

reference.title: Dumbbell Power Clean
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Weightlifting, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

exercise.mechanics: Compound (deadlift-style first pull, explosive triple extension, shrug and pull, catch)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace before the dumbbells leave the floor, hold through the pull and the catch, breathe out standing tall.
breathing.cadence: Smooth first pull, fast second pull and catch, controlled return to the floor

prescription.tempo: Controlled first pull, explosive second pull, stick the catch
prescription.load: User-chosen dumbbells light enough to move fast; stop while every rep stays crisp. In barbell clean derivatives peak power came at light to moderate loads (Suchomel 2014).
prescription.frequency: 1-2 times a week, early in the session
prescription.progression: Master the hang clean first; add load while the catch stays crisp

cues.text: Dumbbells beside the feet, hips back and down, flat back, chest up, arms long.
Push the floor away; keep the back angle until the dumbbells pass the knees.
Jump: hips, knees and ankles extend, shrug, then pull the elbows high and out.
Turn the elbows forward and catch the dumbbells on the shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall with the dumbbells on the shoulders.
Lower to the sides, then hinge with a flat back and set the dumbbells down beside the feet.
Reset the brace before the next rep.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to reach the floor
mistakes.fix: Bend the knees more and keep the chest up; start from blocks if needed.

mistakes.mistake: Hips shooting up first off the floor
mistakes.fix: Keep the back angle constant until the dumbbells pass the knees.
Keep the arms long until the legs and hips have extended.
Drop into a quarter squat as the dumbbells land.

kinematics.setup: Knees ≈110°, hip flexion ≈139°, trunk ≈45° forward, hips 43.6 cm high (shoulders 70.3 cm)
kinematics.peak: Dumbbells 3.1 cm off the floor beside the feet (rig estimate)
kinematics.norm: Hips below the shoulders, back flat, shoulders over or just in front of the load (NSCA Essentials, power clean)

kinematics.peak: ≈38° as the dumbbells pass the knees (knees ≈42°)
kinematics.norm: Trunk angle held constant until the load passes the knees (NSCA Essentials)
Quarter squat, upright trunk, elbows forward (NSCA Essentials)

kinematics.setup: 0.5 s set, 0.55 s first pull to the knees
kinematics.peak: 0.5 s second pull and turnover, 0.2 s absorb, 0.9 s stand, 0.35 s hold, 1.7 s back to the floor, 0.7 s reset
kinematics.norm: Controlled first pull, explosive second pull (NSCA Essentials); controlled return (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #488912, Dumbbell Power Clean, video (movement reference)

Caulfield, Hornsby & Haff, power exercises: power clean (and hang power clean variation), excerpt from NSCA Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning, 5th edition (Haff & Triplett, eds.; Human Kinetics)
Suchomel, Wright, Kernozek & Kline 2014, kinetic comparison of the power development between power clean variations (J Strength Cond Res 28(2):350-360)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
The dumbbell load is your choice: pick a weight you can move with the form shown for every rep.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Fast lifts: learn the positions slowly with a light dumbbell first, keep the dumbbells close to the body and clear a space around you.
Low-back pain: the floor start loads the back most; use the hang clean or start from blocks.
modify: Limited hip or ankle mobility: start with the dumbbells on low blocks.
Rack discomfort: rest the dumbbells lightly on the shoulders.
regressions: Dumbbell deadlift to learn the start.

muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Drive the explosive hip extension of the second pull, then help absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Drive the explosive hip extension of the second pull, then help absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.quads_r: Push the floor away in the first pull, extend explosively in the second pull and absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.quads_l: Push the floor away in the first pull, extend explosively in the second pull and absorb the catch.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Hold the hinge at the hang and extend the hips with the glutes.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Hold the hinge at the hang and extend the hips with the glutes.
muscleNotes.calves_r: Rise onto the balls of the feet at the top of the extension (the heels may lift, NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.calves_l: Rise onto the balls of the feet at the top of the extension (the heels may lift, NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Shrug the shoulders up at the end of the extension, before the elbows bend.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Shrug the shoulders up at the end of the extension, before the elbows bend.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Lift the elbows high and out in the pull.
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Lift the elbows high and out in the pull.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Turn the elbows forward and up into the rack position.
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Turn the elbows forward and up into the rack position.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells are pulled up and turned over; control the lowering.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Bend the elbows as the dumbbells are pulled up and turned over; control the lowering.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Grip the handles through the pull and the catch.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Grip the handles through the pull and the catch.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold the flat back from the floor; the trunk angle stays the same until the dumbbells pass the knees (NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold the flat back from the floor; the trunk angle stays the same until the dumbbells pass the knees (NSCA Essentials).
muscleNotes.core: Brace before the drive and stay braced in the catch.
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Help extend the hips from the deep start position.
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Help extend the hips from the deep start position.
